title: Visited cells after one initial step
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean work-tape symbols and state set $S$, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $c$ be a configuration on $x$. For every natural number $t$ and work-tape index $j$, the cell occupied by tape $j$'s head in $c$, together with the cells visited by that tape from the one-step successor of $c$ through step $t$, is contained in the cells visited from $c$ through step $t+1$.
hypotheses_covered: A deterministic multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols and state set $S$
